tasks.title: Convert HF + WEATHER_TINT to CSS variable references
acceptance_criteria: Every HF.* value is a var(--c-*) reference per the spec mapping; no hard-coded hex remains in HF.
Every WEATHER_TINT entry is a var(--c-tint-<type>) reference.
tempColor(t) is unchanged (still returns a computed rgb()).
The module's exported shape (HF keys, WEATHER_TINT keys, tempColor) is unchanged so no consumer breaks.
tests: HF.ink resolves to a var(--c-ink) reference and HF retains all original keys
WEATHER_TINT has a var() reference for every weather type key
tempColor(20) still returns an rgb() string (unchanged behavior)

tasks.title: Define light + dark CSS tokens and drive the body from them
acceptance_criteria: :root defines all --c-* tokens with the current light values (visually identical to today).
:root[data-theme="dark"] overrides every --c-* token with the proposed dark palette, including all 11 --c-tint-* tints.
body background, gradient stops, and color read from --c-* variables (no remaining hard-coded page colors).
Print and reduced-motion blocks still force sensible colors (print stays light paper).
No token is left undefined in either mode.
tests: index.css defines a :root[data-theme="dark"] block overriding --c-ink and --c-paper (asserted by reading the stylesheet)

tasks.title: ThemeToggle component
acceptance_criteria: Renders a single icon button that reads useTheme() and calls cycle() on click.
Shows a distinct icon per mode (light=sun, dark=moon, auto=auto glyph).
Has an accessible name (aria-label) that reflects the current mode.
Clicking cycles light -> dark -> auto and updates the icon/label.
Uses var(--c-*) tokens for its own colors so it themes with the page.
tests: clicking the toggle calls cycle and advances the mode (light -> dark)
the button exposes an aria-label reflecting the current mode
each mode renders its distinct icon/label

tasks.title: Place ThemeToggle in the public header
acceptance_criteria: ThemeToggle is rendered in the public header (near the header meta / date block).
Header layout remains intact on desktop and the <=720px mobile breakpoint (does not break the existing flex/column layout).
tests: App renders a theme toggle button in the header
